---
title: "jaxcmr.experimental.finite_window_race"
---

{{< include _generated/experimental-finite-window-race/_body.qmd >}}

Pass `FiniteWindowRace` as `response_policy_create_fn` to a compatible model
factory. In ordinary CMR the drift for each item is `race_drift_scale` times
the context-to-item memory output, before choice sensitivity or normalization.
